units.source_text: 其中一本是《维摩经》的《众香之国》，

en.t: One of them is The Land of Many Fragrances from the Vimalakirti Sutra,

units.source_text: 描写圣者们坐在吐放着各式芳香的花丛中，

en.t: which describes sages sitting among flowers that give off all kinds of fragrance,

units.source_text: 各自嗅着不同的芬芳，悟出了真理——

en.t: each smelling a different scent and awakening to truth:

units.source_text: 从一种香气认识一个真理，

en.t: from one fragrance they came to know one truth,

units.source_text: 然后从另一种芳香又认识另一个真理。

en.t: and then from another fragrance they came to know another truth.
